summary:
Results-driven professional with over 1 year of hands-on experience in CNH Business System (CBS) initiatives at
CNH Industrial. Skilled in driving process optimization, lean manufacturing, cost reduction, and quality
improvement through data-driven problem solving. Experienced in implementing Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream
Mapping (VSM), Standard Work, and KPI tracking across manufacturing operations. Adept at collaborating
cross-functionally to enhance productivity, eliminate waste, and sustain an operational excellence culture.

bullets: Supported the deployment of Lean and CBS tools across manufacturing operations to improve process efficiency and reduce non-value-added activities.
Conducted Kaizen workshops focused on improving throughput, reducing rework, and enhancing workplace organization through 5S principles.
Assisted in VSM studies to identify bottlenecks and developed improvement action plans in collaboration with production teams.
Collected and analyzed KPI data (Productivity, downtime, rejection,rework, material loss, etc.).
Led mini projects on cost-saving and process optimization, resulting in measurable improvements in cycle time and material usage.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams (Production, Maintenance, and Quality) to implement standard work and visual management systems.
Participated in audit preparation and continuous improvement reviews as part of the CBS deployment roadmap.
Supported digital transformation and data-driven dashboards for monitoring performance and improvement initiatives
